Brief: Tell me about the Hubble Space Telescope and what it has discovered. — about C/2014 UN271 (Bernardinelli–Bernstein)

1. Cometary activity in 2014 UN271 was first reported on 22 June 2021, by Tim Lister at Las Cumbres Observatory's telescope in Sutherland, South Africa and by Luca Buzzi at the SkyGems Remote Telescope in Namibia.
2. C/2014 UN271 was observed by the Hubble Space Telescope in January, March, July, August, and October 2022.
